capabilities: display relative line numbers in the editor gutter
work in Live Preview and legacy editor modes
extras: The README warns that the built-in 'Show line numbers' option must be turned off first for the plugin to work.
problem: Obsidian's editor only offers plain absolute line numbers (or none), so users who rely on relative numbering for navigation have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: Legacy mode borrows some code from the original Relative Line Numbers plugin.

summary: Editor plugin that displays Vim-style relative line numbers in the gutter, working in both Live Preview and legacy editor modes.
